privacy.collectAccount: Dashboard account data: when you sign in with Discord OAuth2, we only request the identify scope to get your Discord User ID, username (Username/Display Name) and profile picture link (Avatar URL). We never request access to your email or private messages
privacy.collectFeatures: Feature data within a server: level points and XP history, welcome card settings and uploaded backgrounds, weather report settings, channel access lists (Room Access / Voice Guard), fund collection topics (Fund) and Jira card or GitHub PR data, only for servers that enable them
privacy.collectGuild: Discord server data (Guild Data): the server ID (guildId), server name, server icon, the server owner's ID (ownerId) and the channel or role IDs that server admins choose in the settings
privacy.collectIntro: We only collect data needed for the bot's features and for signing in to the Dashboard, namely:
privacy.collectLogs: Activity and security history (Activity & Audit Logs): server events that server admins choose to log, plus sign-in history and setting changes on the Dashboard (including IP address and User-Agent, to prevent attacks and for security reviews)
privacy.isolationAdmin: Bot administrators (Role ADMIN): keep the shared system stable and manage user accounts when technical problems come up
privacy.isolationIntro: All data in the database is clearly separated by server ID (guildId), and access is controlled with Role-Based Access Control:
privacy.isolationOwner: Server owners (Role OWNER): can see and manage only their own servers (where they are the Server Owner or have Manage Server / Administrator). They cannot see other servers or other people's Discord channel lists
privacy.isolationTitle: Per-Server Isolation and Access Control (Role-Based Isolation)
privacy.isolationUser: Regular users (Role USER): only see servers they own or can manage, in rankings-only mode (Levels). They cannot change bot settings
privacy.retentionAuto: Server events (Activity Events) and XP history are deleted automatically once they pass the system's retention period
privacy.retentionKick: When the bot is kicked from a server, it immediately stops collecting new data from that server
privacy.retentionRequest: You can disconnect your Discord account or log out of every device on the My Account page, and you can contact the developers at any time to permanently delete your account or a server's data
privacy.securityPasswords: Dashboard account passwords (if set) are one-way hashed with bcrypt
privacy.securitySecrets: Secrets for external services, such as Jira API tokens, are encrypted with AES-256-GCM before being stored and are never sent back to the web page
privacy.securitySession: Sign-in sessions use HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite cookies with Refresh Token rotation, and every request that changes data is protected against CSRF
privacy.securityWebhook: GitHub webhooks have their HMAC-SHA256 signature verified before every processing
privacy.subtitle: This document explains how Bot_NotStack and the Dashboard website (bntdash.arlifzs.com) collect, use and protect your data and your Discord server's data.
